description.value: White Rock Beach Beer Company is a locally-owned craft microbrewery founded in 2013 by two White Rock secondary school teachers who built the operation from scratch. The brewery operates a tasting room and lounge adjacent to its production space on Russell Avenue, where visitors can sample a range of house-brewed beers from light lagers and pilsners to a Baltic-style porter and a highly-hopped IPA. Its tagline 'Because beaches and beer go better together' reflects its identity as a neighbourhood hangout close to the White Rock waterfront.
